verdict.rationale: Devin supports background autonomy via API-triggered sessions, MCP 'scheduling' capability, cloud sessions that persist after the user disconnects, and CI/CD-triggered Auto-Fix loops that iterate without a human in the loop — all consistent with setting up autonomous background automations. However, community reports raise concrete reliability caveats about unsupervised long-running autonomy (working for days when stuck, reluctance to ask for help, need to manually cap work time), suggesting the autonomous background mode requires active babysitting rather than being fully hands-off. Missing for 10: a dedicated scheduling/cron UI or docs page, independent verification that scheduled/background automations run reliably unattended, and clearer first-party detail on the 'scheduling' feature mentioned only briefly in MCP docs.
